articles.title: He lives with his parents and loves Jesus. Meet Gen Alpha's new heartthrob.
articles.summary: Malachi Barton opens up about "Coven Academy" and his rise as Disney's latest heartthrob.
articles.body:
Young girls are pledging their allegiance to Malachi Barton.

I saw it with my own eyes at the Descendants/Zombies: Worlds Collide tour last summer: tweens and teens yelling "Malachi!" like their lives depended on it while waving pink American flags with his face on them. That was before he even stepped onstage.

"A couple of those, yeah," Barton tells Yahoo in our latest Generation Now interview, laughing when I mention the flags.

"Honestly, I still don't look at myself as that person," he adds.

But he is. At 19, Barton is Disney's latest heartthrob — like the Jonas Brothers and Zac Efron before him — and the company is banking on him. He's starring in a trifecta of key projects: vampire Victor in the Zombies movies and aspiring musician Fletch in the Camp Rock revival film, both on Disney Channel, and now warlock Jake in the Coven Academy series on Freeform. He's also headlining the next leg of the Descendants/Zombies/Camp Rock: Worlds Collide tour , and surprise-released his first single, "Stay for the Credits."

Malachi mania is not merely a Mouse House push. Variety honored him with its Rising Star Award at the 2026 Power of Young Hollywood event in August.

As his star soars, Barton still lives with his parents, Felicia Barton, an American Idol Season 8 alum, and tour manager Loren Barton. He says praying is his "No. 1 outlet," though he's also into surfing, urbexing (aka urban exploration), his car and watches. He surrounds himself with friends who will tell him to "get off [his] high horse."

The bigger his profile gets, the more his personal life has become part of the conversation too. And with Coven Academy premiering Oct. 1 on Freeform (Disney+ and Hulu the next day), Barton is entering yet another big chapter.

Barton seems intent on keeping one foot in normal life even as the other lands on increasingly bigger stages. Here, he talks about navigating both.

I saw full Malachi mania last summer when I took my daughter to the 'Worlds Collide' tour. I've been at this a long time, but I was stunned by the reaction your presence created. What's it like to be that person to people?

It's very weird and very crazy. I will be scrolling on TikTok and a TikTok Live will pop up and this girl will have a cardboard cutout of me behind her. And I'm like, OK, that's not weird at all, but also really cute [ laughs ].

I'm super grateful, that's all I can really say. I'm so grateful to be in a position where I can have a voice to so many young kids and be able to spread kindness and the light of Jesus in all things. Having that platform is super, super rad. I'm so grateful.

You're close with your family, and your faith is obviously important to you. How do those things keep you grounded?

Those are the two things, 100%. I have the best parents ever. Since I was a little, little dude, I've been in baseball and had outlets and other things outside of the business, because this business is crazy. So much fun [too], but it's also wild and up and down. You've got to have your other outlets. My No. 1 outlet is the man upstairs. Those are my grounding factors, for sure.

What's your living situation these days? Do you still live with your parents?

I do — I live with my parents. I love my parents. I love living with them. I bought my first house a little while ago, so that's been really, really wild. I feel like I'm never home anyway. My living situation is literally all over the place. First, we're in Vancouver [shooting Coven Academy ], next we're in New Zealand [for Zombies 5 ]. It's so cool because I get to travel around and see so many different parts of the world. But, yeah, I live with my parents, and we have my two little dogs, Artex and Ranger, and my car.

A BMW M3 . It's outside right now. It's my baby.

You graduated from high school last year. Did you have a traditional-ish school experience? Your graduation looked pretty normal.

I did online [school]. I went to a public elementary school for second and third grade, and then I did online [learning] for literally as long as I can remember. But I feel like I got the high school experience because all of my friends — my tight group of people — aren't in the business, and they were all in high school. So I was doing my school at home, but then I was going to all the football games, the homecomings, the proms, the formals. The teachers knew my name. I was kind of an honorary member of their school.

Honestly, I give a lot of [credit] to my friends because they've grounded me. If I come fresh off a set, they will check me very, very quickly and be like, "Get off your high horse." That's the best thing. So I got a little bit of high school, and my graduation was completely normal.

You experienced the gossip side of fame this summer. How do you deal with that?

I think it's always going to be there. You can't avoid it at all. People will always have an opinion, and that is how this business is. That's what you're signing up for. But the thing I remind myself is that the only opinion that matters is God's. People will continue to speculate and say certain things, and that's OK. They have freedom of speech. They can say whatever they want to. I just do my own thing: stay in my lane, stay at the beach, stay in my car and vibe out.

Your schedule this year is insane: a show, TV movies and a tour. How do you spend a day when you're off the clock?

I literally surf. I'm always in the ocean, and I love [it] so much. The ocean is the most physically and mentally healing place on the planet. That's what I do on my days off. Also, I'm getting into urbexing, which is exploring abandoned places. That's a new thing.

I went to this abandoned golf course in California. It was really cool. I can't expose the location because then it's not going to be abandoned or underground [ laughs ]. You gotta gatekeep.

Are you ever worried someone is going to come chasing after you? I'd be too nervous.

That's what makes it fun, though. The fact that you're not able to do it makes it so much fun.

You're the tween crush now. Who was your celebrity crush when you were younger?

Oh my goodness. … I have been a Jessica Alba guy for a very, very long time. Through and through. Love you, Jessica. I'm trying to think of my tween crush, though — I was always a big Madelyn Cline guy. I loved Outer Banks . And then Florence Pugh — come on, big shout-out. Come on, y'all know ball. Let's go, Florence Pugh, love you. I love all of them.

What's the last thing you binge-watched?

Coven Academy . We got that encrypted link — [the one that's like] Yo, don't send this to anybody. The FBI shows up to your house if you try and screen-record it . I sat down on my couch and binge-watched it in literally the shortest amount of time you can watch it. I just sat there and banged it out.

Is your email address also a giant watermark across the screen while you watch, like it is for me?

Yes, but honestly, the show is so good I just looked past it the whole time [ laughs ].

What is your go-to late-night snack after a night out? Full order.

Taco Bell — 100%. Taco Bell is banger. My order is the chicken Cantina quesadilla, but that's not in season right now. So the chicken Cantina burrito is what is in season at the moment. And then a Mexican pizza. I feel like that's the vibe. Taco Bell all the way — or, if a Chipotle's open, there we go.

How many tattoos do you have, and what do they mean?

I think I have eight or so. This one right here is [based on] Proverbs 27:21 , which says: "The purity of gold and silver is tested by putting it in the fire, and the purity of the human heart is tested by giving it a little fame." That's a scripture that my grandpa texted me a lot. Then I have "family" in Morse code , matching with my parents. I've got Jesus being taken off the cross on my rib, and then I have a sword on my stomach. My first tattoo was three little crosses on my ankle. I have Joshua 1:9 tattooed on my back. I have my parents' names in a cross on my back, and the coordinates to my favorite surf spot, that's matching with my best friend, on my [back].

Now I just need to get a BMW tattoo somewhere. I'll get it on my lower back. It's gonna be lit.

Does this point in your career feel like something you imagined, or has it surpassed what you pictured?

Honestly, I didn't have any expectations going into this. With anything that I do, I just go in like, all right, what happens, happens. You can't control everything. You can't. The world's going to happen how it's going to happen, and you've just got to be hands-off. That's how you live more peacefully, in my opinion.

So I went hands-off, and it blew the expectations that I didn't have out of the water. I never in a million years would have thought — if I were to tell my 8-year-old self, signing his first Disney contract, that this was going to be the case [11, 12 years] later — I never would have believed it. Mind blown.

articles.title: Festival Breakfast Weekend reúne opções diversas de café da manhã a partir de R$ 39,90 na cidade de SP | G1
articles.standfirst: Breakfast Weekend começa neste sábado (26) e reúne hotéis, cafeterias, padarias e restaurantes com combos e buffets especiais; programação segue até 25 de outubro.
articles.summary: Breakfast Weekend começa neste sábado (26) e reúne hotéis, cafeterias, padarias e restaurantes com combos e buffets especiais; programação segue até 25 de outubro.
articles.body:
Café da Manhã. — Foto: Divulgação/Recanto Cataratas Thermas Resort & Convention.

Ainda não sabe o que fazer neste fim de semana? Uma opção para quem gosta de começar o dia com calma e, de preferência, com uma mesa cheia, é aproveitar a nova edição do Breakfast Weekend , que começa neste sábado (26) em São Paulo .

O festival chega à 10ª edição reunindo hotéis, cafeterias, padarias e restaurantes da capital com menus especiais de café da manhã. A programação vai até 25 de outubro, com opções em formato de combo ou buffet e preços entre R$ 39,90 e R$ 129,90.

A ideia é justamente transformar a primeira refeição do dia em programa: dá para escolher desde uma cafeteria para um café mais rápido até aproveitar o buffet de um hotel sem precisar estar hospedado.

Entre os participantes estão nomes como Hilton Morumbi, Grand Mercure Ibirapuera, InterContinental São Paulo, Novotel Morumbi, Mercure Jardins, Nacional Inn Jaraguá, Canopy by Hilton Jardins, WZ Jardins, INNSiDE by Meliá Iguatemi e Itaim, além de unidades da rede Ibis, Cakess, Sweet & Sugar e Padoca do Jaca.

O festival começou em São Paulo com foco principalmente nos cafés da manhã de hotéis, mas, ao longo das edições, ampliou a lista de participantes e passou a incluir também cafeterias, padarias e restaurantes espalhados pela cidade.

Na prática, é uma chance de conhecer lugares novos ou finalmente experimentar aquele café da manhã de hotel que normalmente passa despercebido por quem mora em São Paulo.

Para quem prefere transformar o café em um programa mais demorado, há opções de buffet. Já quem quer encaixar o passeio antes de seguir para outra atividade pode escolher os estabelecimentos que oferecem combos fechados.

Antes de sair de casa, porém, vale conferir as regras do local escolhido. Horários, cardápios, necessidade de reserva e disponibilidade variam entre os participantes.

📅 Quando? De 26 de setembro a 25 de outubro

📍 Onde? Hotéis, cafeterias, padarias e restaurantes da capital

articles.title: Taylor Swift releases 4 new songs for 'Life of a Showgirl: The Encore.' What do critics say?
articles.summary: Swift's songwriting has been called "captivating" and "shockingly tender," though one critic dismissed the new tracks as "derivative and flat."
articles.body:
Taylor Swift has added a final act to her record-breaking album The Life of a Showgirl .

Almost a year after the album's release, Swift dropped The Life of a Showgirl: The Encore on Friday, featuring four new songs: "Patient Zero," "Cleveland!," "Pink Clouding" and "Babylon."

The new songs extend what was already a historic run for The Life of a Showgirl . The album debuted last October with 4.002 million equivalent album units in the U.S. — the biggest week for an album since modern tracking began in 1991 — and became the first album to occupy all of the top 12 spots on the Billboard Hot 100.

Despite its success, a deluxe edition wasn't part of the plan.

Swift appeared to rule out more songs last year, telling the New Heights podcast, "There are no other songs coming… This is 12. There's not a 13th, there's not other ones coming."

Swifties kept looking for clues anyway. Seven months before The Encore arrived, her "Opalite" video included a poster reading "Patient for the Encore" and four judges holding up zeroes. This week, Swift swapped the Os in her social media bios for zeroes and started a countdown that revealed the title of "Patient Zero."

Despite arriving as an add-on to an album released nearly a year ago, the new tracks are getting plenty of attention in their own right. But are the surprise additions worth the encore?

What are critics saying about 'The Life of a Showgirl: The Encore'?

Music critics have been deeply divided by The Encore .

USA Today 's Melissa Ruggieri said the four new songs "deserve an ovation." Of "Patient Zero" itself, she writes, "Her staccato vocal delivery glides over a smooth groove that is augmented by strings in the background, but it's the bridge — it's always the bridge — that shines."

Variety 's Chris Willman said it was "refreshing to get something fast and easily digestible" from Swift, adding, "three of the four new tracks on The Life of a Showgirl: The Encore prove she has no intention of turning in her Tortured Poets membership card any time soon."

The Globe and Mail 's Aisling Murphy said the new tracks were "markedly better" than the rest of The Life of a Showgirl , adding, "A showgirl knows to save her best tricks for the grand finale."

Much of the praise has focused on Swift's songwriting. Ruggieri said the lyrics on "Babylon," the closing track, were "captivating," while Willman called the writing on "Pink Clouding" "shockingly tender."

Others questioned whether the new material adds much to The Life of a Showgirl . The Telegraph 's Poppie Platt gave The Encore one star, calling the songs "derivative and flat" and arguing that Swift's enormous commercial success means she "no longer has the incentive to take creative risks."

The Independent 's Roisin O'Connor was also unimpressed, arguing that the songwriting feels recycled from Swift's older, better work. In her two-star review, she added, "Where is Swift, artistically, now? Because it sounds like she's flailing."

Slate 's Carl Wilson said the tracks "sound fairly similar" to the ones on The Life of a Showgirl , "and similarly are at best a couple of notches above half-successful." He described "Patient Zero" as "perfectly passable, with lilting cadences you'll hum along with when it's playing and likely forget until it plays again," adding, "Maybe we've gotten all the growth from Swift we'll ever get."

Laura Snapes of The Guardian argued that the new material lacked cohesion, saying: "It's hard to tell what any of this has to do with Showgirl (other than pushing the album back to No 1 until Christmas). Every song sounds as though it could have been appended to a different record."

"Cleveland!" has been the most divisive song on The Encore . Many reviewers believed the love song references Swift's husband, Travis Kelce, with the line "He already took me to Cleveland / And showed me The Heights." Kelce grew up in Cleveland Heights, Ohio, and Swift has appeared as a guest on his podcast, New Heights .

Ruggieri called the track the catchiest of the four, but O'Connor felt it contained "some of her worst writing," while Wilson said that the song "sucks," as do "all her big love songs about Travis Kelce so far."

Willman said he couldn't decide whether it would "grow on me or gnaw at me," and Business Insider 's Callie Ahlgrim predicted it would "go down as one of the worst songs in Swift's discography."

Why did Taylor Swift release 'The Life of a Showgirl: The Encore'?

The four songs weren't leftovers from the original album. Swift wrote them after The Life of a Showgirl was released in October 2025, when she traveled to Sweden with longtime collaborators Max Martin and Shellback to celebrate its success.

"Really, we just wanted to reflect and take in how grateful we were for the moment we were in, but there was a studio there, and we did what we do when we feel anything at all: We wrote more songs," Swift said when announcing The Encore .

The musician said the songs were "born out of pure gratitude" for fans' response to the album.

The release comes just days before Swift returns to the MTV Video Music Awards , where the music video for "Patient Zero," starring Dakota Johnson and Colin Farrell, will premiere Sunday.

Swift will also receive the inaugural Artist Director Honors award at the ceremony. The new award recognizes music artists whose work behind the camera has pushed creative boundaries and advanced visual storytelling.

The honor will also break Swift's tie with Beyoncé as the most decorated artist in VMAs history. The two entered this year with 30 Moon Person awards apiece; the Artist Director award will bring Swift's total to 31.

articles.title: Madrid amanece llena de puertas verdes pintadas: sólo la periodista Gloria Serra puede desvelar la razón
articles.standfirst: La presentadora de ‘Equipo de Investigación’ es protagonista para anunciar la llegada de una nueva película
articles.summary: La presentadora de ‘Equipo de Investigación’ es protagonista para anunciar la llegada de una nueva película
articles.body: Madrid es una de las ciudades más sorprendentes del mundo entero. En la capital de España no paran de suceder cosas. Pues bien, a lo largo de toda la urbe aparecieron, en la mañana de este viernes, 25 de septiembre, pintadas verdes, en forma de puerta, sobre los muros de los domicilios. Gloria Serra, reconocida periodista de nuestro país y presentadora de ‘Equipo de Investigación’, desveló el motivo por el que la ciudad madrileña amaneció de esta manera. Filmin subió un reel en el que Serra era protagonista para investigar el caso de las puertas verdes en Madrid. La periodista se hizo varias preguntas al respecto: “¿Son simples señales? ¿Una puerta a lo desconocido? ¿O una broma del héroe Merlin?”. Las puertas verdes son las entradas a ‘los backrooms’: “Una dimensión desconocida, fuera de nuestro entendimiento. Nosotros intentamos entrar, pero no lo conseguimos. (…) Hemos encontrado muchas por toda la ciudad, cargadas de misterio”. Del mismo modo, la periodista afirmó que había muchas más en la Plaza Mayor, una zona “cinéfila” y de “cine polaco”. Una viandante que entrevista en la pieza afirma que si te acerca a la puerta “escucharás cine polaco en versión original”. “Una versión de Boyero con más ojos”, apuntó otro. Para finalizar, Gloria Serra logró entrar a través de una de las puertas que accedió a la oficina de Filmin. Tras ello, una persona en el interior dijo lo siguiente: “¡Cogedle y ponedle una peli de Tarkovsky!". Lo que se estrena será ‘Backrooms’, la cinta que ya está disponible en la plataforma desde este viernes, 25 de septiembre. “Un umbral que conecta su salón con el mejor cine”, sentenció la presentadora de ‘Equipo de Investigación’.

articles.title: Motivational quote of the day by Denzel Washington: ‘Dreams without goals are just dreams, and they ultimately fuel disappointment,' a powerful life lesson on discipline, consistency and ambition
articles.summary: Denzel Washington's powerful quote emphasizes the importance of setting goals and maintaining consistency to turn dreams into reality. Explore insights from his 2015 commencement speech at Dillard University and discover how discipline can lead to success.
articles.body: Everyone has a dream. It could be a career, a business, a creative project or simply a life that looks different from the one they have now. But having the dream is usually the easy part. The harder part is doing the same work for it when the excitement wears off.Denzel Washington spoke about exactly that during his 2015 commencement address at Dillard University in New Orleans. Instead of telling graduates that success would come simply because they had big ambitions, he talked about what had to happen after the dream was there: setting goals, staying disciplined and, most importantly, continuing to show up.Today’s quote of the day by Denzel Washington reads: “Dreams without goals remain dreams and ultimately fuel disappointment.”The line came as part of Washington's wider message to the Dillard University graduating class. In the speech, which Dillard University later shared on its official YouTube channel, he spoke about failure, faith, gratitude and the difference between simply having a dream and actually working towards it. He added, "On the road to achieving your dreams, you must apply discipline but more importantly consistency.”What does the quote by Denzel Washington mean?Washington’s point is pretty simple: Wanting something doesn’t equal working for it.A dream can stay in your head for years if there is no plan behind it. That is where goals come in. Instead of only thinking about the big result, a person has to figure out what needs to happen along the way and then actually do those things.But Washington puts even more weight on consistency. Discipline can get you started, but there will be days when motivation disappears. You may get tired, lose confidence or simply have other things competing for your attention. Continuing anyway is what starts to make the difference.That idea was part of a larger speech. According to a transcript of Washington's Dillard address, he told graduates that “a dream without goals is just a dream” and then connected achievement with discipline and consistency. The 2015 speech also included his advice to “fail big” and his reminder that people should use their lives to make a difference.The context is important because Washington was not talking to established professionals. He was speaking to students who were just leaving university and starting the next part of their lives. His message was essentially that graduation was not the finish line. There was still work to do.How is the quote by Denzel Washington relevant today?It is easy to relate to the idea of having a dream but struggling with the part that comes after it. People often make ambitious plans at the beginning of a new year, semester or job and then find it harder to stick with them a few weeks later.That is where Washington's emphasis on consistency comes in. You do not necessarily need to make huge progress every day. Sometimes it is simply about continuing to work on something instead of abandoning it because the results are taking longer than expected.The quote is also useful because it separates goals from vague ambition. Saying you want to become successful does not tell you what you are actually going to do. A goal gives the dream somewhere to go.Washington's own speech was full of this kind of practical advice. Reporting on the 2015 Dillard commencement, TheGrio noted that he gave the graduates four main pieces of advice, including putting God first, failing big, remembering that life is about more than material possessions and saying thank you in advance for what is already yours.There is also something quite realistic about the quote. It does not say that discipline or consistency will make success automatic. It says they are part of the road towards it. Dreams can still change, plans can go wrong and some goals may take much longer than expected.Early life of Denzel WashingtonDenzel Hayes Washington Jr. was born on December 28, 1954, in Mount Vernon, New York. He initially attended Fordham University and studied journalism before becoming interested in acting.His career did not happen overnight. Washington began working in theatre and television before making his way into films. One of his early major screen roles came in the medical drama series 'St. Elsewhere', where he played Dr. Philip Chandler.The role helped make him familiar to television audiences, but Washington was also building a film career at the same time. He appeared in movies such as 'A Soldier's Story' and 'Cry Freedom', with the latter earning him an Academy Award nomination.His early career already showed the range that would later become one of the defining parts of his work. He moved between television, theatre and film instead of staying in one particular type of role.How did Denzel Washington rise to fame?Washington became one of Hollywood's most recognised actors through a series of performances that brought both critical attention and major audiences.His performance as Private Trip in 'Glory' earned him the Academy Award for Best Supporting Actor in 1990. The Academy records the win as Washington's first Oscar.He followed it with roles in films including 'Malcolm X', 'Philadelphia', 'The Pelican Brief', 'The Hurricane' and 'Remember the Titans'. His performance as Malcolm X earned him another Best Actor Oscar nomination, showing how quickly his career had moved from television to some of the biggest roles in American cinema.In 2002, Washington won the Academy Award for Best Actor for his role as Alonzo Harris in 'Training Day'. The Academy notes that the win made him the second African-American actor to win the Best Actor Oscar and the first African-American actor to win Oscars in both the leading and supporting categories.His career continued with films such as 'American Gangster', 'Flight', 'Fences', 'The Equalizer' and 'The Tragedy of Macbeth'. articles.title: ‘Princess Diaries’ Star Heather Matarazzo Reveals She May Lose Health Insurance If She Doesn’t Work Again Soon: ‘Lots of Actors’ Are in the ‘Same Boat’
articles.summary: “Princess Diaries” star Heather Matarazzo revealed she may not qualify for health insurance if she doesn’t find work soon. The actress, who starred alongside...
articles.body:
"Princess Diaries" star Heather Matarazzo revealed she may not qualify for health insurance if she doesn't find work soon.

The actress, who starred alongside Anne Hathaway in the "Princess Diaries" films as Lilly Moscovitz, replied to a post from "Atypical" actor Jack Haven that revealed they needed work in order to qualify for health insurance through SAG-AFTRA.

The guild offers a health plan for its members that requires a "minimum earnings" threshold be met to qualify. However, booking projects in the entertainment industry is often unpredictable and fluctuates, which leads to larger gaps between employment opportunities and ultimately makes meeting that threshold more difficult.

"I'm in a bit of an emergency situation," Haven shared in a YouTube video this week. "I need to make $4,000 by the end of the month in order to qualify for SAG health insurance starting in January."

The actor shared their skills and said they will do "pretty much any job," encouraging anyone open to hiring them on a production under SAG to contact them over email.

Matarazzo replied to a post about Haven's plea, writing, "I am literally in the same boat right now. Lots of my fellow actors are. I remember a time when we didn't have to earn a minimum to qualify for insurance. Glad to see that Jack has gotten an offer that will let them to qualify for 2027."

As detailed on the SAG Health Plan's eligibility page , the minimum threshold is expected to rise by approximately $900 each year until 2030. This year, members were required to earn $28,933. SAG-AFTRA did not respond immediately to comment.

Matarazzo's most recent project was the 2025 short film "Paper Tiger." She also starred "Welcome to the Dollhouse," "The Devil's Advocate" and "Scream 3," as well as multiple episodes of Netflix's "Wednesday."

articles.title: Gisele Bündchen Ended Her Marriage to Tom Brady With Just 3 Words
articles.summary: The former couple, who share two kids, divorced in 2022.
articles.body:
Tom Brady is the subject of an upcoming biography.

In Lars Anderson's Brady: An American Story and the Price of Greatness , a source close to the athlete claims that Gisele Bündchen was the one who ended their marriage.

Brady and Bündchen share two kids and were married for over a decade before divorcing in 2022.

A new book about Tom Brady reveals how his marriage to Gisele Bündchen crumbled. He and the supermodel were together for over a decade before divorcing in 2022.

In Lars Anderson's upcoming biography Brady: An American Story and the Price of Greatness , a source close to the athlete claims that Bündchen was the one who ended their relationship.

"One day, Gisele, who is really into astrology, basically looked into the stars and told Tom, 'We're not compatible,' and just like that, she was done," reads an excerpt published in the Daily Mail .

Anderson writes that Bündchen wanted Brady to retire from football as early as 2017, though his decision to continue playing put strain on their marriage.

According to Anderson, after Brady and the New England Patriots won the 2019 Super Bowl, Bündchen asked: "Would now be the perfect time to retire?"

"Too bad, babe. I'm having too much fun right now," Brady allegedly responded.

Anderson's book also claims that Bündchen wrote Brady a pointed message after the Patriots lost the 2018 Super Bowl.

"She needed him to be present when he was at home, not responding to text messages on his constantly buzzing cell phone or replaying a game in his mind," the author writes. "She needed more help with the kids. She needed the chance to sleep in just a few days a week. She needed more time for her own career."

A friend of Brady's explained how his career might have caused tension within his marriage.

"The guy gets up at the crack of dawn, thinks all day about a game that is foreign to his wife, comes home and is in bed each night by nine," the source said, according to Anderson. "He can't really eat out or go out without causing a scene. Everything he puts in his mouth tastes like shit. The whole lifestyle had to be getting tiresome for Gisele."

After playing with the Patriots for nearly two decades, Brady signed with the Tampa Bay Buccaneers in 2020, though he eventually retired in 2023.

Brady and Bündchen share two children—Vivian and Benjamin—while Brady also has a son named Jack from his relationship with Bridget Moynahan. Bündchen has since remarried, tying the knot with jiu-jitsu instructor Joaquim Valente in 2025. The couple welcomed their first child that same year.

articles.title: Oscar Piastri: I need a tow bar to hook onto Mercedes to fight for Baku win
articles.summary: Mercedes' pace in Baku means it's going to be difficult for anyone to compete with George Russell for the win
articles.body:
Having qualified third in Baku after enduring a difficult build-up to the main sessions, Oscar Piastri was happy with the grid position he earned for Formula 1's Azerbaijan Grand Prix.

However, the McLaren driver thinks expecting to go much further in the race is unrealistic, given the gap to Mercedes . While the Australian lost just 0.001s to Charles Leclerc in Q3, the deficit to George Russell was a massive 0.838s.

So when he was asked during the post-qualifying press conference whether he could challenge the Briton in the race, Piastri resorted to sarcasm.

"If he's got a tow bar that I can hook onto the back of, maybe," he smiled. "But yeah, we'll see what we can do."

Given the gap Russell managed to build over his rivals, it's easy to suggest his Mercedes team-mate Kimi Antonelli would have joined him on the front row had he not crashed in Q1 - and at a track where it's relatively easy to overtake, it's not entirely out of the question that Antonelli could still challenge Piastri in the race.

What's more, the McLarens didn't look particularly strong during the practice sessions, which could serve as a hint that the papaya cars may actually be on the defensive rather than the attack on race day. Piastri conceded that the weekend has been difficult for the Woking squad - but qualifying delivered a somewhat unexpected result.

Having not finished higher than sixth in any of the practice sessions, he was even briefly first during Q3, but that wasn't really a representative picture at a track which doesn't particularly suit this year's McLaren car.

On top of that, Piastri experienced a brake issue on Friday morning, forcing his team to use some unusual methods to combat the vibrations - tying some parts together with cable ties in order not to lose track time.

"It's been not an easy weekend, for sure, from a few areas," Piastri said. "You know, we've not been particularly quick. We were also running cable ties on our car through Friday, which is never a great sign. So it's been a little bit of a tricky one for us.

George Russell, Mercedes, Oscar Piastri, McLaren

"In qualifying we found a bit of pace. So, yeah, it's not the first time that's happened to us this year. We seem like we're a bit on the back foot through practice, we come out in qualifying and, yeah, we just find that bit extra.

"I was pretty surprised to see us 1-2 after the first lap of Q3, but unfortunately, we had no hope against George."

Still, the Australian reckons McLaren can fight the other teams on Saturday.

"The Mercedes look incredibly quick here," he said, "but everyone else looks like they're in a similar-ish kind of pack. And our race pace looked pretty good yesterday, to be honest. So I think we can hang on and battle in the pack behind George, and see what lap Kimi starts coming through as well."

Piastri's team-mate Lando Norris will line up fifth on the grid.

articles.title: Cliente encontra pérola ao comer ostra em restaurante; VÍDEO | G1
articles.standfirst: Carina Lisboa encontrou a esfera ao provar um prato com ostra exótica em Cananéia. Restaurante participava de festival gastronômico voltado ao uso da espécie invasora.
articles.summary: Carina Lisboa encontrou a esfera ao provar um prato com ostra exótica em Cananéia. Restaurante participava de festival gastronômico voltado ao uso da espécie invasora.
articles.body:
Você já imaginou encontrar uma pérola ao comer uma ostra ? A situação parece roteiro de uma série de comédia, mas foi o que aconteceu com a personal trainer Carina Lisboa em Cananéia , no litoral de São Paulo ( assista acima ). Ao g1 , ela contou que só notou a pequena esfera que se assemelha a uma pérola quando já estava com ela na boca.

"Dei uma mordida e senti uma coisa dura. Eu falei: 'Nossa, acho que quebrei o meu dente, deve ter um pedaço de ostra aqui dentro'. Aí comecei a mexer e vi que tinha uma bolinha, que não tinha sido dente", relembrou a personal, de 41 anos.

O episódio ocorreu no restaurante Ponto das Ostras, no Centro da cidade. A proprietária do estabelecimento, Paula Monteiro, contou que foi a primeira vez que isso ocorreu com um cliente em 18 anos de comércio. "Meu pai trabalha com ostra desde os 13 anos e ele nunca tinha visto uma história dessa", explicou.

Pérola foi encontrada em um prato servido em um restaurante de Cananéia — Foto: Arquivo Pessoal

O prato em que a esfera foi encontrada havia sido feito para o 1º Festival GastroMangue, promovido pela prefeitura com apoio da Universidade Estadual de São Paulo (Unesp) com o objetivo de desafiar restaurantes a criar receitas usando a ostra exótica Saccostrea cucullata.

Originária da Ásia, a ostra é considerada invasora porque tem se espalhado pela região, onde disputa espaço com espécies nativas. Dessa forma, o festival foi idealizado para transformar um problema ambiental em novas possibilidades gastronômicas e ajudar a discutir alternativas para o controle da espécie, extraída por pesquisadores da Unesp.

Ao g1 , Carina contou que estava fazendo uma caminhada com o aluno Jordinei Francisca no domingo (20) quando teve a ideia de almoçar no restaurante de Paula, amiga que havia lhe convidado para experimentar o novo prato envolvendo a ostra exótica.

A personal convidou o aluno para o almoço e, no estabelecimento, ainda encontrou a irmã e a cunhada. Todos estavam almoçando quando Carina sentiu a esfera na boca.

"Eu peguei a bolinha e falei: 'Gente, eu acho que achei uma pérola'. Aí todo mundo começou a rir na mesa", afirmou Carina, dizendo que todos duvidaram da raridade.

A personal chamou a proprietária do restaurante para mostrar a pequena esfera, que também ficou surpresa com o achado.

" Foi um daqueles momentos completamente inesperados, que a gente não planeja e que acabam virando uma história para contar . Para nós, foi uma experiência inusitada e inesquecível", explicou o cabeleireiro Jordinei, que gravou o vídeo mostrando a pérola.

Pérola foi encontrada durante almoço de Carina com o aluno Jordinei Francisca — Foto: Arquivo Pessoal

Carina disse que entrou em contato com uma especialista em joias que confirmou se tratar de uma pérola ainda em formação. A personal trainer pretende transformá-la em um brinco de ponto de luz.

"Foi engraçado e foi um presente. Fiquei bem feliz porque eu sou muito da natureza, então eu creio que isso foi um presente de Deus para mim", explicou.

Os biólogos Alex Ribeiro e Ricardo Samelo explicaram que as pérolas são formadas por um mecanismo de defesa de moluscos bivalves, como ostras e mexilhões.

"O processo inicia quando um corpo estranho invade o corpo do animal. O sistema de defesa reconhece a partícula e tenta isolar a mesma criando um revestimento ao redor dela. Com o passar do tempo, mais material vai sendo adicionado, formando assim a pérola", afirmou Samelo.

De acordo com ele, o processo pode levar semanas, meses ou até anos. Os biólogos analisaram as imagens da esfera encontrada por Carina e acreditam que realmente se trata de uma pérola devido à assimetria dela.

"A pérola geralmente não é uniforme, como dá para a gente ver na imagem. Depois que os produtores pegam, ela é lapidada e passa por um processo para virar uma joia", disse Ribeiro.

Segundo o especialista, pérolas podem ser produzidas naturalmente, como provavelmente foi nesse caso, ou de forma artificial, em que produtores realmente inserem corpos nas ostras para estimular o mecanismo de defesa.

Ribeiro disse ainda que a cidade é conhecida pela produção de ostras por conta da qualidade da água e das condições ambientais da região. "As melhores ostras do estado de São Paulo são oriundas do litoral sul de Cananéia", afirmou.

articles.title: Caetano Veloso faz 'Coração vagabundo' bater de novo ao louvar João Gilberto em música do álbum de Cézar Mendes | G1
articles.body:
Capa do single 'João', de Cézar Mendes (à direita) com Caetano Veloso — Foto: Bob Wolfenson / Divulgação

♬ Conta o violonista e compositor baiano Cézar Mendes que, ao concluir o samba-canção “João” (2020), ele o mostrou ao muso inspirador da música, João Gilberto (10 de junho de 1931 – 6 de julho de 2019), e informou ao criador da bossa nova que a composição ganharia a voz de Caetano Veloso no álbum que Mendes planejava gravar.

Passaram-se anos entre a intenção e a realização, mas eis que “João” chegou ao mundo ontem, sexta-feira, 25 de setembro, como amostra inicial do segundo álbum de Cézar Mendes, o primeiro em que o artista se apresentará como intérprete, dando ele próprio voz a um cancioneiro autoral composto geralmente em parceria com Arnaldo Antunes, letrista de “João” e dos outras músicas do álbum previsto para ser lançado em novembro em edição da Uns Produções.

Só que, no caso de “João”, quem canta a música sozinho é mesmo Caetano Veloso em gravação que faz todo sentido dentro da trajetória do baiano tropicalista, devoto de João Gilberto desde 1958.

E tudo se afina não somente porque foi Caetano Veloso quem apresentou o conterrâneo santo-amarense Cézar Mendes ao Brasil como compositor – em 1998, 40 anos após a revolução de João – ao abrir parceria com o violonista na criação de “Aquele frevo axé”, samba cheio de bossa lançado na voz de Gal Costa (1945 – 2022) como música-título do álbum lançado pelo cantora naquele ano de 1998.

Quando Caetano canta os versos de “João”, louvando um dos mestres da música brasileira, é como se ele estivesse fazendo uma volta ao começo e fazendo bater novamente “Coração vagabundo”, a canção de 1967 que abriu o álbum dividido por Caetano com a mesma Gal Costa, então a Gracinha também devota de João. Tudo ali naquele dueto seminal era João e, por isso, tudo se encaixa agora em 2026.

A gravação de “João” por Caetano ecoa o dueto com Gal em 1967 inclusive por mostrar que, para ir na essência de uma canção – a lição maior deixada por João – nem sempre é preciso optar pela economia instrumental.

Diferentemente do que faz supor a foto de Bob Wolfenson na capa do single “João”, a gravação rejeita o formato minimalista de voz e violão. As cordas da St. Petersburg Studio Orchestra envolvem a gravação produzida e arranjada com esmero por Mario Adnet, também violonista da banda que inclui músicos como o ritmista Marcelo Costa (com bateria de toque reverente à leveza exigida por João Gilberto), o baixista Jorge Helder, o pianista Marcos Nimrichter e o flautista Eduardo Neves.

Parece muito, e é mesmo, mas tudo e todos estão em fina sintonia com João Gilberto.

Caetano Veloso (em pé) canta o samba-canção 'João' (2020) no segundo álbum do violonista Cézar Mendes, previsto para ser lançado em novembro — Foto: Bob Wolfenson / Divulgação

articles.title: Luminosidade do cristal de Gal Costa reluz no 81º aniversário da cantora porque 'coisas sagradas permanecem' | G1
articles.standfirst: Artista recebe homenagens nas redes sociais de fãs e de cantores como Gilberto Gil e Maria Bethânia.
articles.summary: Artista recebe homenagens nas redes sociais de fãs e de cantores como Gilberto Gil e Maria Bethânia.
articles.body:
Gal Costa (1945 – 2022) é celebrada nas redes sociais por artistas como Gilberto Gil e Maria Bethânia — Foto: Mauro Ferreira / g1

♬ Todo dia é dia de recordar e louvar Gal Costa (26 de setembro de 1945 – 9 de novembro de 2022). Mas hoje é um dia especial. A imortal cantora baiana estaria completando 81 anos neste sábado, 26. A data nem é redonda, como os 80 anos festejados pelo séquito da artista em 2025, mas todo aniversário de Gal atiça a saudade de seguidores e amigos da cantora.

Grandes nomes da MPB – como Gilberto Gil e Maria Bethânia – hoje estão celebrando Gal nas redes sociais, fazendo a luminosidade da voz da cantora reluzir neste 81º aniversário da artista. Uma voz que era um cristal. Coisa de Deus, como sentencia a sábia Bethânia, única remanescente da geração de grandes cantoras da MPB que irromperam na década de 1960.

Gal se foi há quatro anos. Elis Regina ( 1945 – 1982) partiu num rabo de foguete no já longínquo ano de 1982 – curiosamente o ano em que o rock deu uma blitz na MPB, como resumiu Gil, e desde então nada mais foi como antes. Nana Caymmi (1941 – 2025), a mais velha desse quarteto fantástico de cantoras gigantes, saiu de cena no ano passado.

Como Elis e como Nana, Gal ficou, mesmo tendo ido. Porque “coisas sagradas permanecem”, como sentenciou Caetano Veloso no verso da canção “Recanto escuro” (2011) – verso, aliás, já batido porque virou clichê falar do canto de Gal como uma coisa sagrada que transcendeu a existência física da artista. “Deus botou ali”, reforça Bethânia ao se referir ao cristal de Gal em depoimento que ressoa hoje nas redes sociais.

Felizmente, o brilho eterno desse cristal está perpetuado nos discos, nas gravações oficiais e extraoficiais de shows – a propósito, será que um dia teremos a benção de ouvir álbuns com os ainda inéditos áudios de show feitos por Gal nos anos 1970? – e nos vídeos que circulam na internet.

articles.title: Quote of the day by Sylvester Stallone: ‘We can’t succeed in everything. Most times, we lose. But the few times we do win, we have to make sure they were the important battles,’ a powerful life lesson explaining that winning the right fight matters more than winning all of them
articles.summary: Explore Sylvester Stallone's impactful quote on success, failure, and the importance of choosing the right battles in life. Discover how his journey from struggle to stardom encapsulates this message.
articles.body: Failure is something almost everyone experiences, but learning what is worth fighting for can change the way we look at it. Sylvester Stallone once spoke about this while reflecting on life, success and the legacy of his most famous character, Rocky Balboa. His words offer a simple idea: we may not win every battle, but the ones that truly matter deserve our effort.Today’s quote of the day by Sylvester Stallone reads: “I’m a big believer that, in life, we can’t succeed in everything. Most times, we lose. But the few times we do win, we have to make sure they were the important battles.”What does the quote by Sylvester Stallone mean?The actor expressed these thoughts in a 2006 interview with Total Film when explaining why he wanted Rocky to be remembered for the inspiration the character gave people. Stallone’s words seem to suggest that success does not have to be measured by winning every argument, competition or challenge. Some fights aren't worth wearing ourselves out over.Disappointments are in life. Plans go awry, opportunities are lost, and sometimes even our best efforts do not give us the result we hoped for. Stallone’s argument is that failure is not necessarily a failure in life. The key thing is knowing where to put our energy.The second part of his thought is especially important. If there are only a few moments when everything falls into place, those moments should involve things that genuinely matter to us. That could mean a career goal, a relationship, family, personal growth or a dream that we have refused to give up on.Why does his message still matter today?Modern life can make success look like a competition that never ends. One person is announcing a new job, another is celebrating an award, while someone else is sharing a new relationship, business achievement or personal milestone.Also, it is important to realise that not every setback needs to stay on our mind, and not every argument is worth spending our energy on. Sometimes, knowing what to leave behind can be just as important as knowing what to fight for. Sometimes, moving forward means knowing what to let go of and where to put your energy. Sometimes walking away from something is also a form of strength.His words also encourage people to think about priorities. Instead of trying to win everywhere, it may be more meaningful to protect the relationships, ambitions and values that matter most.Sylvester Stallone’s early lifeBorn on July 6, 1946, in New York City, Stallone did not enter Hollywood with an easy path to success. A medical complication at the time of his birth left Stallone with partial paralysis affecting some facial muscles. That condition became part of Stallone's distinctive screen presence, from the way he spoke to the expressions he made while acting.His journey in Hollywood was anything but smooth. Long before audiences knew him as an action star, Stallone took whatever small acting work he could find. Money was often tight, and finding steady work was not easy.With acting opportunities limited, he started putting more time into writing. It was a decision that eventually opened a completely different door for him. The story he wrote would go on to change the course of his career.Sylvester Stallone’s rise to fameEverything changed for Stallone when 'Rocky' arrived in 1976. He had written the screenplay and also played the lead, and the film quickly turned into a major success. It also earned him Academy Award nominations for his performance as well as his writing.Ultimately, “Rocky Balboa” was far more than a character in a boxing movie. His story touched people's hearts because it's about getting back up when things go wrong and continuing to believe in yourself. articles.summary: Mushtaq Khan passed away on Thursday evening at the age of 62. He had been battling cancer for a prolonged period.
articles.body: Mushtaq Khan passed away on Thursday evening at the age of 62. He had been battling cancer for a prolonged period. The veteran actor worked across several Hindi films and television shows during his career. His performance as Ballu in 'Welcome' remains among his best-known roles. The 2007 film was directed by Anees Bazmee. It featured Akshay Kumar, Katrina Kaif, Nana Patekar and Anil Kapoor in prominent roles.Mushtaq Khan had once shared an anecdote involving Salman Khan during the making of 'Welcome,' the movie that featured Katrina Kaif in the lead. The actor also spoke about questions surrounding Salman Khan's relationships.When Mushtaq Khan was asked about Salman Khan's dating daysIn an old interview with Filmymantra, Mushtaq Khan was asked about Salman Khan's dating life. He was specifically questioned about whether Sangeeta Bijlani had visited Salman Khan on a film set. The actor was also asked whether Salman Khan had visited Sangeeta Bijlani during shoots. Mushtaq Khan said such personal matters were not topics of discussion among them.He responded, "Iss tarah ki baatein humne kabhi kari bhi nahi aur kabhi poochha bhi nahi (We have never even discussed such things, nor have we ever asked about them).”Mushtaq Khan then recalled an occasion involving Salman Khan during the Dubai schedule of 'Welcome'. He said, “I have never seen Sangeeta ji come to the set to meet him, but once, when we were shooting the film 'Welcome' in Dubai, Salman came to the hotel there."Anupam Kher remembers Mushtaq KhanFollowing Mushtaq Khan's demise, several members of the film industry shared tributes. Anupam Kher posted a video remembering his professional association with the late actor.Anupam Kher recalled a period when the two actors worked together on several projects. He mentioned films associated with Mahesh Bhatt and Satish Kaushik.“There was a time when we worked together on a lot of films - Mahesh Bhatt's films, Satish Kaushik's films, and many others. Then we walked on our own paths. But I will always remember the days I spent with him."Anupam Kher also remembered Mushtaq Khan's personality and sense of humour. He added, "Mr Mushtaq was a very simple man. He had a great sense of humour. And I have never seen him angry."Suniel Shetty and Paresh Rawal pay tributeSuniel Shetty also expressed his grief after Mushtaq Khan's death. The actor remembered the veteran performer through a message on social media.Suniel Shetty wrote, "This one hurts. Some people leave behind memories that will always make you smile. My heartfelt condolences to the family. Rest in peace." Paresh Rawal also paid tribute to Mushtaq Khan. He remembered the late actor for his personality and his work as a performer.Paresh Rawal wrote, "Mushtaq Khan. Loving human being and an exciting actor. REST IN PEACE."Mushtaq Khan's career spanned films and television. articles.body: 'Vvan: Force of the Forest ', starring Sidharth Malhotra and Tamannaah Bhatia, opened in theatres on September 25, 2026. The fantasy thriller takes place in an ancestral village in Bihar. The film combines folklore, supernatural forces and a conflict surrounding a forbidden forest.'Vvan: Force of the Forrest' collects Rs 8.00 crAccording to Sacnilk, 'Vvan: Force of the Forrest' earned Rs 8.00 cr in India net on Day 1. The collection came from 6,746 shows across the country. The film's India gross collection stood at Rs 9.60 cr on its opening day.The Day 1 figures also bring the film's total India net collection to Rs 8.00 cr. The opening-day numbers were recorded on Friday, September 25, 2026.The Vvan Movie ReviewFilm records 28.25% overall occupancyThe Hindi 2D version of 'Vvan: Force of the Forrest' registered 28.25% overall occupancy on Day 1. The night shows recorded the highest occupancy during the opening day. Night screenings registered 41.46% occupancy. Evening shows recorded 26.08%, while afternoon screenings registered 24.00%. Morning shows recorded 12.23% occupancy.The film had 6,746 shows across the country on its first day. Its India net collection stood at Rs 8.00 cr at the end of Day 1.Sidharth Malhotra plays RishiSidharth Malhotra plays Rishi, a rational man raised in an urban setting. He travels back to his ancestral village in Bihar with his wife Mamta. Tamannaah Bhatia plays Mamta in the film.Rishi returns to sell the land he inherited from his family. His visit also coincides with Chhath Puja celebrations. However, his plans change after he encounters the village's beliefs surrounding a forbidden forest. The villagers have strict warnings about the forest. Nobody is permitted to enter it after sunset. Rishi does not accept their beliefs and instead supports Deepak, played by Sunil Grover. Deepak wants to clear a section of the forest to improve connectivity.Rishi awakens an ancient supernatural forceRishi eventually enters the forbidden forest despite the warnings. During his visit, he breaks an ancient seal. This action unleashes a supernatural force that challenges his understanding of reality. The story places Rishi in a conflict involving greed, development and supernatural powers. He must also confront the ancient folklore surrounding Vandevi and the forest.The central premise follows Rishi as he awakens a divine goddess. He then finds himself facing forces that exist beyond conventional logic. His journey turns him into an unlikely saviour who must protect the villagers from annihilation.Deepak Kumar Mishra and Arunabh Kumar direct the film'Vvan: Force of the Forrest' has been directed by Deepak Kumar Mishra and Arunabh Kumar. The film presents a rational urban man confronting supernatural forces after challenging the traditions of his ancestral village.ETimes' review of the film reads, "The Vvaan: Force of the Forrest has the ingredients of a more layered fantasy thriller but never brings them together consistently. Its atmosphere, visual ambition and intriguing premise work in its favour, while rushed character development and an increasingly conventional supernatural conflict limit its impact. What could have been a nuanced tale about faith, greed, development and the consequences of disturbing nature instead becomes a moderately engaging supernatural adventure that only partially fulfils the potential of its premise."DISCLAIMER: The box office numbers and the data in this article are compiled from public and industry sources. articles.title: Dolly Parton's Young cancer survivor fan celebrates ‘9 to 5 Day’ at the hospital
articles.summary: Over the years, Dolly Parton invested in a lot of endeavours and believed in giving back to the community.
articles.body: Over the years, Dolly Parton invested in a lot of endeavours and believed in giving back to the community. Earlier this year, she donated a generous amount to a children’s hospital in Knoxville, which was renamed the Dolly Parton Children's Hospital in February 2026, only a few months before her passing.In a recent announcement, the children’s hospital revealed plans to hold a ‘9 to 5’ party to honour Dolly Parton’s commitment to charitable causes and her significant impact on countless individuals. At the centre of the celebration was 9-year-old Hattie Halter, a longtime fan of Parton and a patient at the hospital.Dolly Parton Children's Hospital to honour her legacy with a partyThe hospital revealed that they would hold a ‘9 to 5’ theme party to honour Parton’s legacy, and Halter, who was diagnosed with cancer when she was only nine months old, also attended the celebration. While talking to PEOPLE, her mother, Mellisa Halter, shared how her entire family will be there.She added, "I and her dad, her two brothers, and Hattie, we’re all going to be there bright and early. Being a part of anything that has to do with Dolly where she gets to talk to people about her, she’s just so excited.” She also recalled the time when her daughter had been diagnosed with leukemia and how harrowing the entire experience was for their family.She recalled, “It’s miserable and scary. You basically have to start treating the cancer as soon as possible so you really don’t have any time to process or think it through. It’s just a very scary thing to go from hoping they crawl and talk soon to, "Oh my gosh, is this going to kill my kid?" It’s something the little cute ‘how to prepare to be a mom’ books don’t necessarily warn you about.”Hattie Halter is a big fan of Dolly PartonHer mother also revealed that she has been a big fan of Parton and her music for years now, adding, “She loves her music, just her accent and the way she sings. And the fact that we have Dollywood here and she sees her everywhere in Tennessee, she just likes to dance and shimmy to her music.”Melissa further added, “I honestly feel like the way she carried herself—she exuded that kind of sunshine and happiness and wanting to help others—is what stuck out too, and Hattie just was attracted to that.”Days after the singer’s passing, the hospital shared a video of their patients and their parents sharing their experiences at the hospital and how they were able to overcome their diseases while remembering Parton. The caption under the post read, “Our patients and families express our feelings best. Dolly’s love and compassion will continue as we carry her light forward for generations to come. Thank you, Dolly.”About Dolly PartonThe country singer left for her heavenly abode on August 25 after a brief battle with cancer. The news of her passing was shared by her nephew, Bryan Seaver, in a video that was circulated on all of her social media accounts. The singer had been admitted to a cancer facility a few days before her passing. She had also chosen not to share her diagnosis with the world until after her demise.Get the latest Bollywood & Entertainment News, and more. articles.summary: Around a year ago, reports confirmed that Kris Jenner had decided to put the iconic ‘Keeping Up With The Kardashians’ mansion on the market.
articles.body: Around a year ago, reports confirmed that Kris Jenner had decided to put the iconic ‘Keeping Up With The Kardashians’ mansion on the market. The online personality had been ready to part ways with the beloved house that appeared in most of the episodes of ‘Keeping Up With The Kardashians ’; however, new reports indicate Jenner is planning on holding on to the mansion for the time being.Kris Jenner pulls the ‘KUWTK’ house from the marketJenner has officially pulled the iconic mansion where most of the episodes of ‘KUWTK’ were filmed off the market. The news comes after the house had been up for sale for more than a year. ELLE Decor reported the news and shared that the mansion, which had earlier been listed for USD 13.5 million, has officially been put on hold, according to property records.Zillow reported that the house was first bought for USD 4 million in 2010 and has been under Jenner’s ownership for the past 16 years. Earlier this year, in May, the home had been briefly removed from the listing; however, she soon put it back up on the market for the same asking price. However, four months later, it has been confirmed yet again that the reality show house is no longer on the market.In another report shared by TMZ, Jenner may have had second thoughts about the home. A statement from the report read, "Kris hesitated to move forward... not because of a lack of interest, but because she started reconsidering the bigger picture.”More about the iconic ‘Keeping Up with the Kardashians’ houseThe property is located in Hidden Hills and spans 8,860 square feet. The mansion features around 6 bedrooms and 8 bathrooms, along with the famous black-and-white checkered foyer with a double staircase that has appeared in many episodes. Along with this, the home also features a massive chef’s kitchen covered in white, along with a large dining table and clear, cushioned chairs for the entire family.Last year, when she first listed the property on the market, the Jenner family matriarch revealed that she was ready for the house to move on to its next chapter. While talking to The New York Times then, she mentioned, “I’ve shared so many unforgettable memories in this incredible home with my family, and I’m excited to see it start a new chapter with its next owners.” She also revealed during the interview that she had spent millions of dollars on the house over the years on renovations and other amenities.During the season 7 premiere of the ‘KUWTK’ OTT spin-off show, ‘The Kardashians,' the Jenner family looked back at their time in the house, where both Kylie and Kendall spent their growing years. articles.summary: Heather Matarazzo, known for 'Princess Diaries,' reveals the risk of losing her SAG-AFTRA health insurance due to lack of work. Discover the challenges actors face within the industry and the rising income thresholds for health benefits.
articles.body: Heather Matarazzo recently revealed that she needs work or else she may soon lose her health insurance under SAG-AFTRA. The organisation requires actors to earn a minimum wage to qualify for health benefits. The 'Princess Diaries' star, who played Lilly Moscovitz in the film, revealed that she needs work to qualify.‘Princess Diaries’ star Heather Matarazzo says she may lose her health insurance without workIn a comment she posted recently, the ‘Princess Diaries’ star revealed that she is at risk of losing her health benefits. Earlier, Jack Haven, star of ‘Atypical’ and ‘I Saw The TV Glow,’ recently went viral for sharing their plight on social media, stating they needed work soon and needed USD 4000 to prevent their SAG-AFTRA health insurance under SAG-AFTRA from lapsing.While replying to an account that had shared the news about Haven’s plight, Heather admitted that she is going through the same thing. She posted, “I am literally in the same boat right now. Lots of my fellow actors are. I remember a time when we didn’t have to earn a minimum to qualify for insurance. Glad to see that Jack has gotten an offer that will let them qualify for 2027.”Heather last appeared in the 2025 film ‘Paper Tiger.' Other than that, she also had a recurring role in the OTT series 'Wednesday' alongside Jenna Ortega. She played the role of Judi Spannagel, the cheerful yet sinister executive assistant to Dr Rachael Fairburn at the Willow Hill Psychiatric Facility in season two of the hit show. Some of her other recent works also include ‘Welcome to the Dollhouse,' ‘The Devil’s Advocate,' and ‘Scream 3.' Other than that, ‘Princess Diaries 3’ is confirmed to be in development; however, it has not been confirmed who all from the original cast will be returning for the movie alongside Anne Hathaway.Jack Haven admits they got a lot of offersSoon after their video went viral online, Haven shared another video on their YouTube channel confirming that they received many work offers after their appeal went viral. The actor, who recently appeared in ‘Teenage Sex and Death at Camp Miasma,' shared, “I got a lot of offers. So, thank you, guys. Thank you for your love and your kindness. I really feel overwhelmed. My manager, Adam, said it was like, It’s a Wonderful Life. I feel kind of crazy, too, because I didn’t really expect [this]. I didn’t expect this many people to see the video.”According to guidelines shared on SAG-AFTRA’s official website, this year, actors qualifying for health benefits under the guild were required to earn a minimum of USD 28,090 for health insurance. It has also been confirmed that the overall amount is going to rise to a total of USD 28,933 from next year onwards. articles.body: Horror film 'Evil Dead Burn' is set to premiere on HBO Max on October 2, giving fans of the franchise a chance to watch the latest instalment ahead of Halloween, Variety reported.One of the year's highly anticipated horror releases, "Evil Dead Burn" had its theatrical release on July 10 and marks the third film since the "Evil Dead" series reboot in 2013 and the sixth film overall in the franchise.Directed by Sebastien Vanicek, the film stars Souheila Yacoub, known for "Dune: Part Two", as a woman who seeks comfort from her in-laws following the death of her husband. The series ran from 2015 to 2018.The fifth film in the franchise, "Evil Dead Rise", was released in 2023. A seventh film, "Evil Dead Wrath", helmed by Francis Galluppi, is slated for an April 2028 release."Evil Dead Burn" has been produced by Raimi and Robert Tapert under their Ghost House Pictures banner. articles.body: Ben Affleck, who shares three children, Violet, 20; Fin, 17; and Samuel, 14, with his ex-wife Jennifer Garner, recently shared a hilarious anecdote about them. Host Kapil Sharma posed a hypothetical question to director Abhishek Pathak about what might have happened if Kajol had been cast in the first 'Drishyam' film.Ajay Devgn’s cheeky answer about KajolDuring the episode, Kapil Sharma asked Abhishek Pathak, “Abhishek sir, if you had cast Kajol ma’am in the first part, don’t you think she would have made you spill everything right there?”Before Pathak could respond, Ajay Devgn jumped in with a characteristically deadpan answer.“The first film wouldn’t have been made,” Devgn said.The remark played perfectly into the central premise of the 'Drishyam' franchise. The story revolves around Vijay Salgaonkar, an ordinary family man who goes to extraordinary lengths to protect his family and conceal the truth surrounding a crime.Vijay’s carefully constructed plan depends on everyone sticking to the same version of events. Kapil’s hypothetical therefore opened the door for Devgn’s light-hearted husband-wife joke — suggesting that Kajol might have made keeping the secret far more difficult.Kajol has never been part of the Drishyam universeKajol, who married Devgn in 1999, has never appeared in the 'Drishyam' franchise. Devgn has headlined the Hindi series as Vijay Salgaonkar across its instalments. Drishyam: The Conclusion brings him back alongside Shriya Saran, Ishita Dutta, Mrunal Jadhav and Jaideep Ahlawat, with Abhishek Pathak returning as director. The upcoming film continues the story of Vijay and his family as the consequences of the events surrounding the earlier films come back into focus.'Drishyam' team joins Ajay Devgn on The Great Indian Kapil ShowDevgn was joined on the couch by Shriya Saran, Ishita Dutta, Mrunal Jadhav, Jaideep Ahlawat and Abhishek Pathak. Jaideep also spoke about his long professional association with Devgn, revealing that the two had previously worked together in 'Aakrosh.' The episode featured several comic moments, including Sunil Grover’s impression of Devgn. Jaideep Ahlawat also joined Krushna Abhishek and Kiku Sharda for their popular Sona-Mona sketch.Former cricketer and commentator Navjot Singh Sidhu also praised Devgn’s calm demeanour, saying, “He doesn’t speak much, but when he does, his words are powerful.”Kapil Sharma further joked about his own equation with Devgn, quipping that despite knowing the actor for around 15 years, their conversations generally remained limited to, “I am fine. articles.title: Prince Harry gives rare update on Prince Archie and Princess Lilibet after U.K. school move
articles.summary: Prince Harry gave a rare glimpse into how Prince Archie and Princess Lilibet are settling into school after their recent move back to the U.K.
articles.body: Prince Harry gave a rare glimpse into how Prince Archie and Princess Lilibet are settling into school after their recent move back to the U.K. The Duke of Sussex spoke about his children on Friday, September 25, 2026, after completing a charity skydive in Ontario. Harry had promised 102-year-old World War II veteran Ed Marshall that he would take part in a jump, with the stunt also helping raise awareness and support for military charities.Once he was safely back on the ground, Harry was asked about life in Britain after returning with Meghan Markle and their two children. “It’s been great. It’s been great to be back on British soil,” Harry said while speaking to CTV. He then joked that, after jumping out of a plane, it was also “great to be back on terra firma, actually!”How are Prince Archie and Princess Lilibet doing at their new school?According to Prince Harry, things are going well for the children. “The kids are happy in school, and it gives me a chance to really focus on Invictus in Birmingham,” he said, referring to the next Invictus Games, scheduled for July next year.The Duke and Duchess of Sussex, along with Archie, 7, and Lilibet, 5, arrived in England on August 26, 2026. The children were expected to start their fall term at a U.K. school after the family’s return, but their first school arrangement lasted only two days.Children were moved to another school after security concerns arose regarding their daily journey. Their spokesperson confirmed that the decision followed discussions with the family’s security team about the practicalities of their arrangements. The couple also made it clear that the decision was not a reflection on the school or its staff. They thanked the teachers for the care Archie and Lilibet had received.Reports at the time said the commute, including traffic and the repeated nature of the journey, had raised concerns for the family’s security team. The children have since started at their new school.Prince Harry reveals Archie and Lilibet had ‘Monday blues’Harry had already shared another small glimpse into his children’s new school routine earlier in the week. During his appearance at the WellChild Awards in London on September 21, 2026, the Duke spoke about the children having a difficult morning before school.“At breakfast this morning, they had a bit of Monday blues,” he told HELLO! Magazine.Prince Harry decided to turn the situation into a conversation instead of simply trying to get them out of the house. He told Archie and Lilibet about what he would be doing that evening and the children and families he would meet through his work with WellChild.“They were genuinely fascinated and asking all sorts of questions,” he said. The Duke added that he and Meghan try to use their work to help their children understand the world around them.The WellChild Awards celebrate children living with serious illnesses and the families and carers supporting them. Harry has been a patron of WellChild since 2007 and attended the 2026 ceremony for the 16th time, according to the charity.The event also gave Prince Harry another chance to talk about how becoming a parent has changed how he experiences the charity's work. He said meeting children and their parents now hits differently because he has Archie and Lilibet of his own.Prince Harry and Meghan Markle’s children are adjusting to life in the U.K.The school change is just one part of a much bigger adjustment for the Sussex family. Prince Harry and Meghan Markle had been living in California with Archie and Lilibet for several years before returning to Britain in August. The couple has kept the exact details of their children’s school and their new home private.The Duke's latest comments suggest that, despite the rushed school change, Archie and Lilibet are now settling into their new routine. The Duke has also been giving occasional glimpses into their everyday life. Earlier this week, he revealed another very relatable detail about the children’s adjustment to Britain — their changing taste in food.Harry joked that “beans on toast” had not gone down particularly well, but Archie and Lilibet have apparently taken to Marmite on crumpets. “They do [approve], they do very much,” he said, adding that the children used to tease him for keeping Marmite in the house.Why did Prince Harry and Meghan Markle return to the U.K.?Prince Harry and Meghan Markle’s return to Britain has put their family life back in the spotlight, particularly after years of raising their children in the U.S. Sources previously said the Prince had been thinking about spending more time in the U.K. and wanted Archie and Lilibet to understand more about the country where he grew up and their family background.For Meghan, who was raised in California, the move also gives their children the chance to experience both sides of their parents’ childhoods.Get the latest Bollywood & Entertainment News, and more. articles.title: Karlos Arguiñano, chef: "Para hacer la tortilla de patatas perfecta no uses queso, usa 6 huevos, 3 patatas y 1 cebolla"
articles.standfirst: El reconocido cocinero desvela la fórmula definitiva para triunfar con la tortilla
articles.summary: El reconocido cocinero desvela la fórmula definitiva para triunfar con la tortilla
articles.body: La tortilla de patatas sigue desatando pasiones y debates acalorados en las cocinas españolas. Karlos Arguiñano, el cocinero más popular de la televisión, ha abordado en múltiples ocasiones este clásico gastronómico en su programa, dejando lecciones imborrables sobre su origen y preparación tradicional. A la hora de posicionarse sobre sus raíces históricas, el chef guipuzcoano lo tiene claro: "La tortilla de patatas, mientras no se demuestre lo contrario, se inventó en Navarra". En la eterna disputa sobre sus ingredientes básicos, el chef vasco no oculta su preferencia por la receta con cebolla, justificando que le aporta una jugosidad indispensable. Para Arguiñano, la diferencia entre opciones es rotunda: "La tortilla sin cebolla es campeona de Europa, pero con cebolla es campeona del mundo". Además, advierte contra los añadidos innecesarios que desvirtúan el plato tradicional, asegurando tajantemente que "la tortilla de patatas con cosas ya es otra cosa. Para la tortilla tradicional no uses queso. Con huevos, patatas, cebolla y sal tienes un manjar". Para lograr el equilibrio idóneo de ingredientes, propone una fórmula fija que nunca falla al cocinar en casa: "Para hacer la tortilla de patatas perfecta no uses queso, usa 6 huevos, 3 patatas y 1 cebolla". Respecto al punto exacto de cocción del huevo, el presentador huye de las posturas extremas y busca siempre la textura justa: "¿Cuajada o más crudita? Para mí, con cebolla siempre y en su punto". Uno de los momentos más delicados de la elaboración es el volteado. Para evitar accidentes trágicos en la cocina, recomienda pragmatismo e instrumentos adecuados: "Para darle la vuelta sin riesgos hay que usar una tapa o un plato llano más grande que la sartén. Nada de hacer malabares en el aire si no dominas la técnica, que se te cae al suelo y te quedas sin comida". Por último, el cocinero arremete contra las alternativas ultraprocesadas del supermercado, reivindicando el valor del trabajo artesanal: "Me gustan todas... menos las que venden envueltas en plástico. ¡Anda! No me digas que después de 6 años en la universidad y dos máster, te compras una tortilla envuelta en plástico. ¡Si tardas 25 minutos! El movimiento se demuestra andando y el cariño cocinando". Defendiendo siempre la cocina hecha en casa, concluye recordando que "la gente que no tiene cariño difícilmente va a hacer feliz a nadie".

articles.title: Javier Ambrossi revela que Miguel Bernardeau no fue la primera opción para 'La bola negra': "Empezó a estar escrita para Héctor Bellerín"
articles.standfirst: El futbolista del Real Betis fue la primera opción para el papel que protagonizó finalmente el actor valenciano
articles.summary: El futbolista del Real Betis fue la primera opción para el papel que protagonizó finalmente el actor valenciano
articles.body: Durante el proceso de creación cinematográfica, los proyectos atraviesan transformaciones inesperadas antes de llegar a la pantalla definitiva. En unas declaraciones recientes, los cineastas Javier Calvo y Javier Ambrossi -conocidos como 'Los Javis'- han compartido los entresijos de la fase de concepción de su largometraje 'La bola negra', dejando al descubierto una sorprendente revelación sobre el origen del personaje que finalmente terminó interpretando el actor Miguel Bernardeau en la ficción. Según explicaron los directores, la búsqueda del actor ideal para dar vida a este perfil clave fue un proceso en constante evolución desde sus primeros borradores. Javier Calvo fue el primero en detallar cómo arrancó la selección de reparto: “Nos dijo que sí se sumaba a la aventura y escribimos el papel para él. Pensamos quién podía acompañar a Álvaro, ¿no?”. Fue en ese instante del proceso creativo cuando la idea de contar con una cara ajena al mundo de la interpretación tradicional cobró fuerza en el equipo. Javier Ambrossi quiso matizar la anécdota y desveló la figura deportiva en la que pensaron originalmente: “Bueno, es verdad que al principio de los tiempos yo tenía a Héctor Bellerín...”. A lo que Javier Calvo añadió entre risas: “Tú lo tenías como de...”, lo dejaba en suspense. El cocreador continuó rememorando los bocetos iniciales que figuraban en la zona de trabajo del proyecto. “Creo que nunca lo he contado”, apuntó Ambrossi. Su compañero apostilló que el futbolista del Real Betis figuraba “como imagen”, motivando a Ambrossi a confirmar la influencia directa que tuvo el lateral en la escritura inicial: “Claro, estaba escrita... Una parte de la historia empezó a estar escrita para Héctor Bellerín”. Finalmente, el guion se adaptó al perfil que buscaban para la pareja protagonista y se decantaron por Miguel Bernardeau tras reformular la dinámica entre los personajes. “No, pero porque Rafael es futbolista. Dijimos: 'Bueno, los orígenes ya... Un músico ya está bien, entonces ahora necesitamos a alguien con técnica, con peso y que pudiera sostener a Álvaro y que pueda guiarle un poco. Nosotros sabíamos que Álvaro iba a estar disponible”, concluyó Javier Calvo sobre la decisión definitiva.
